v_390bc593f3.speaker: crew
v_390bc593f3.text: At least it's a job opportunity...

v_43c6981888.speaker: crew
v_43c6981888.text: I really need a job right now... but nobody's hiring.

v_aa31376fb8.speaker: crew
v_aa31376fb8.text: I think I'll give them a call.

v_47ba4ec337.speaker: walt
v_47ba4ec337.text: A gray frank, or a bun with a bite

v_c1cf019c10.speaker: walt
v_c1cf019c10.text: Add only what they asked for. Nothing extra.

v_3e0ee35e67.speaker: walt
v_3e0ee35e67.text: And still no faces. Remember faces.

v_49ea459c4e.speaker: walt
v_49ea459c4e.text: And the Mart's sign never goes out. Remember that.

v_453481aeab.speaker: walt
v_453481aeab.text: And tonight? You work late. Same cart.

v_e2bb909676.speaker: walt
v_e2bb909676.text: Bakery shelf. Grab a pack of buns.

v_2aff5aba97.speaker: walt
v_2aff5aba97.text: Bank clock's ticking fine today. See?

v_aa8a792ef8.speaker: walt
v_aa8a792ef8.text: Bigger grill on the Mart's back wall.

v_4c08a77b08.speaker: walt
v_4c08a77b08.text: Bring the buns back to the cart.

v_b4488d3e3a.speaker: walt
v_b4488d3e3a.text: But listen. This is the only time

v_5f21741fe7.speaker: walt
v_5f21741fe7.text: But you noticed it. That counts for a lot.

v_05a4971c0f.speaker: walt
v_05a4971c0f.text: Buy a package, bring it back and restock.

v_5c6b1d82f7.speaker: walt
v_5c6b1d82f7.text: Careful crossing. Get hit, and you drop it.

v_777f3a31f8.speaker: walt
v_777f3a31f8.text: Check your food before it goes out.

v_5a291cac97.speaker: walt
v_5a291cac97.text: Clock stops? Trailer lights off, count five, on.

v_5e6ad5ccea.speaker: walt
v_5e6ad5ccea.text: Close her window when things get strange.

v_933d4e8f5a.speaker: walt
v_933d4e8f5a.text: Come back when the lamps come back.

v_b4d0d15b59.speaker: walt
v_b4d0d15b59.text: Don't come back till it drives away.

v_207b69886d.speaker: walt
v_207b69886d.text: Don't refuse her. Don't make her wait.

v_b810c25424.speaker: walt
v_b810c25424.text: Don't watch the Walker. Not for a second.

v_c51033ba49.speaker: walt
v_c51033ba49.text: Don't wave back. Don't even look up.

v_2bace8f043.speaker: walt
v_2bace8f043.text: Evening, Rookie. Your first night shift.

v_fdecec3844.speaker: walt
v_fdecec3844.text: Evening. Can you see the bank clock?

v_8dfa5ac79a.speaker: walt
v_8dfa5ac79a.text: Evening. Folks upstairs might wave tonight.

v_bb244b4d5d.speaker: walt
v_bb244b4d5d.text: Evening. You're doing better than I ever did.

v_1d61b96fc0.speaker: walt
v_1d61b96fc0.text: Every time you look at them,

v_2a60a01908.speaker: walt
v_2a60a01908.text: Eyes on your grill. They'll get bored.

v_bec5a77758.speaker: walt
v_bec5a77758.text: First, flip the sign to open the shop.

v_c7cc517b76.speaker: walt
v_c7cc517b76.text: Flip the sign to OPEN when you're ready.

v_59de9131d7.speaker: walt
v_59de9131d7.text: Flip the sign to open the shop first.

v_1a5ba95b8a.speaker: walt
v_1a5ba95b8a.text: Forget I said that. Grill's waiting.

v_77d7d5ddd5.speaker: walt
v_77d7d5ddd5.text: Frank in the bun, at the board.

v_0e89f34ad8.speaker: walt
v_0e89f34ad8.text: Frank on the grill. Follow the arrow.

v_43d577d49f.speaker: walt
v_43d577d49f.text: Go home. Rest. You did more than most.

v_018df6ea49.speaker: walt
v_018df6ea49.text: Go to the Mart. Stand under the OPEN sign.

v_82b173e4a0.speaker: walt
v_82b173e4a0.text: Good. Don't think about it too hard.

v_f5786934d1.speaker: walt
v_f5786934d1.text: Got a rookie on the cart today!

v_fe98fbb9c0.speaker: walt
v_fe98fbb9c0.text: Grab a frank from the cooler.

v_f18ad4c49f.speaker: walt
v_f18ad4c49f.text: Grill's hot. Go sell some dogs.

v_62b7c1f198.speaker: walt
v_62b7c1f198.text: Hand it over. Press Serve on them.

v_c4b4199e89.speaker: walt
v_c4b4199e89.text: Head to the Mart, across the street.

v_01e9cb0131.speaker: walt
v_01e9cb0131.text: Heard you caught Quentin in the act. Nice.

v_bdd60a41bd.speaker: walt
v_bdd60a41bd.text: Her lights reach far. Folks respect a light.

v_a90d44024d.speaker: walt
v_a90d44024d.text: Here. The money's from Walt's own till.

v_811b01e885.speaker: walt
v_811b01e885.text: Hold Restock at the bun crate.

v_d6c0f7b3d1.speaker: walt
v_d6c0f7b3d1.text: Hold Restock on the bun crate.

v_44cc648b89.speaker: walt
v_44cc648b89.text: Hold Slice Bun at the bun crate.

v_284e1fe6b6.speaker: walt
v_284e1fe6b6.text: I can't put you on nights anymore.

v_29efab1ee5.speaker: walt
v_29efab1ee5.text: I know. I know. I'll explain someday.

v_332f5e2477.speaker: walt
v_332f5e2477.text: I need you to believe that.

v_a2820c8e6c.speaker: walt
v_a2820c8e6c.text: I never come to your corner at night. Never.

v_38638ffe24.speaker: walt
v_38638ffe24.text: I used to count the lamps. It helps.

v_b85c836266.speaker: walt
v_b85c836266.text: I watched every one. From in here. Best seat in town.

v_0520e8b100.speaker: walt
v_0520e8b100.text: I worked that corner forty years. Since '.

v_8c6e2a6e3e.speaker: walt
v_8c6e2a6e3e.text: I'll ring when the sun goes down.

v_ad5ef21bc4.speaker: walt
v_ad5ef21bc4.text: I'll walk 'em through it. Help 'em out.

v_054a31ca2c.speaker: walt
v_054a31ca2c.text: I'm sorry I didn't tell you sooner.

v_753e1a5dc5.speaker: walt
v_753e1a5dc5.text: If a long car parks across the street

v_8d5ba32f12.speaker: walt
v_8d5ba32f12.text: If it stops, the trailer's lights fix it.

v_fc6687f0d7.speaker: walt
v_fc6687f0d7.text: If someone knocks and says it's me —

v_274f2ca8ca.speaker: walt
v_274f2ca8ca.text: If someone walks up with no face —

v_b482d41d3e.speaker: walt
v_b482d41d3e.text: In the trailer? Close the window. Stay inside.

v_ea7a8ff8ec.speaker: walt
v_ea7a8ff8ec.text: It goes right on the grill.

v_a8a7e4d43c.speaker: walt
v_a8a7e4d43c.text: It waits on the warmer. Now slice a bun.

v_71c594aea2.speaker: walt
v_71c594aea2.text: It'll keep your head on straight.

v_95c173356c.speaker: walt
v_95c173356c.text: It's ready! Collect it off the grill.

v_fe3359bf17.speaker: walt
v_fe3359bf17.text: It's ready. Grab it off the grill.

v_5a21ee812c.speaker: walt
v_5a21ee812c.text: Just one Mr. Pickett today, I hope. Heh.

v_ec926ce7f3.speaker: walt
v_ec926ce7f3.text: Keep an eye on it. And an ear. It ticks.

v_1d08673bd5.speaker: walt
v_1d08673bd5.text: Keep away till the knocking stops.

v_687c3ecc5a.speaker: walt
v_687c3ecc5a.text: Keep her light on. That's half the job.

v_df7e666039.speaker: walt
v_df7e666039.text: Keep the grill hot. See you at six.

v_a2fdcbe997.speaker: walt
v_a2fdcbe997.text: Keep the rules, and they stay polite. That's the deal.

v_55c8992c1e.speaker: walt
v_55c8992c1e.text: Ketchup! Hold Add at the ketchup.

v_a4c9b50ca9.speaker: walt
v_a4c9b50ca9.text: Ketchup, mustard, a smile. That's the job.

v_edddd48333.speaker: walt
v_edddd48333.text: Keys are under the mustard. See you around, Rookie.

v_c81a42e8ee.speaker: walt
v_c81a42e8ee.text: Knocking? It's not me. Window shut, or off to the Mart.

v_a1ea9ee63f.speaker: walt
v_a1ea9ee63f.text: Lamps going out? Go to the Mart sign.

v_e19decc557.speaker: walt
v_e19decc557.text: Let 'em walk up to the counter.

v_86fc6d358d.speaker: walt
v_86fc6d358d.text: Lights off. Count to five. Then back on.

v_5d5f113c26.speaker: walt
v_5d5f113c26.text: Long car? Window shut, or off to the Mart.

v_0eec32dec6.speaker: walt
v_0eec32dec6.text: Long night, huh? Coffee's on me.

v_34bbe03ebc.speaker: walt
v_34bbe03ebc.text: Look at their shirt. Their watch. Backwards.

v_88e28aaf0d.speaker: walt
v_88e28aaf0d.text: Look both ways! These drivers don't brake.

v_d1bcd03c81.speaker: walt
v_d1bcd03c81.text: Look both ways... These drivers don't brake.

v_108eef5f14.speaker: walt
v_108eef5f14.text: Mart's across the street. Follow the arrow.

v_43762f0ece.speaker: walt
v_43762f0ece.text: Messed one up? Toss it. No harm done.

v_1f825b36ad.speaker: walt
v_1f825b36ad.text: Money goes in the drawer. It's banked when you close.

v_501d4e992e.speaker: walt
v_501d4e992e.text: Morning! Cheese came in. Folks love cheese.

v_834b65a6d0.speaker: walt
v_834b65a6d0.text: Morning, Rookie! I'll stay on the line.

v_5e55db4a7b.speaker: walt
v_5e55db4a7b.text: My knees are done. But you... you notice things.

v_88915625ed.speaker: walt
v_88915625ed.text: New gear's already on the cart. Heh.

v_f8e3b504fd.speaker: walt
v_f8e3b504fd.text: New stuff: potato sticks. Kids love 'em.

v_25a246467d.speaker: walt
v_25a246467d.text: Nice and normal. Just how I like it.

v_b826ff9af4.speaker: walt
v_b826ff9af4.text: Nice and normal. Sell some dogs.

v_f11a4878f9.speaker: walt
v_f11a4878f9.text: Nice! Money goes in the drawer.

v_4625f58fd1.speaker: walt
v_4625f58fd1.text: Night two. You did fine last night.

v_2a2a48314d.speaker: walt
v_2a2a48314d.text: No trailer yet? Then the clock behaves. Heh.

v_15b35dc656.speaker: walt
v_15b35dc656.text: Nobody's made it to ten since... well.

v_41c88ed0c0.speaker: walt
v_41c88ed0c0.text: Now bring 'em back to the cart.

v_c3656c8b1f.speaker: walt
v_c3656c8b1f.text: Now put the hot dog in the bun, on the board.

v_ed7b6fe884.speaker: walt
v_ed7b6fe884.text: Oh — keep an eye on your cash drawer.

v_3c184b0aa2.speaker: walt
v_3c184b0aa2.text: On the cart? Walk to the Mart. Wait there.

v_612160108c.speaker: walt
v_612160108c.text: One more thing, Rookie. The old trailer.

v_f4ff4d0a44.speaker: walt
v_f4ff4d0a44.text: One more thing. This is important.

v_483120d4a5.speaker: walt
v_483120d4a5.text: One of them is a copy.

v_7a6c86186b.speaker: walt
v_7a6c86186b.text: Only what they asked... nothing extra.

v_d8753a68f3.speaker: walt
v_d8753a68f3.text: Pop a frank in the bun.

v_3d7389670d.speaker: walt
v_3d7389670d.text: Refuse the backwards one. Serve the real one.

v_4011b47cdd.speaker: walt
v_4011b47cdd.text: Regular cars never stop there. That one does.

v_2cc4800ac3.speaker: walt
v_2cc4800ac3.text: Rookie. Listen close. This one matters most.

v_ddb13fb986.speaker: walt
v_ddb13fb986.text: Rookie... there's something you should know.

v_f4abef1c3a.speaker: walt
v_f4abef1c3a.text: Rough night. Let's try that again.

v_86f1064bd1.speaker: walt
v_86f1064bd1.text: Running low on stuff? The Mart's across the street.

v_8ed1c15f7e.speaker: walt
v_8ed1c15f7e.text: Running low? The Mart's across the street.

v_8efe822ecf.speaker: walt
v_8efe822ecf.text: Same cart. Same grill. Different customers.

v_7c3b2950e5.speaker: walt
v_7c3b2950e5.text: See that sign? FOR SALE. Go take a look.

v_9b6108722e.speaker: walt
v_9b6108722e.text: See the bubble? That's the order.

v_a8df473b9a.speaker: walt
v_a8df473b9a.text: See you at sunrise. I promise.

v_a7784c977a.speaker: walt
v_a7784c977a.text: Serve her. Always. Whatever she asks for.

v_88d475f302.speaker: walt
v_88d475f302.text: She liked you. The lady. I can tell.

v_0c9378db1f.speaker: walt
v_0c9378db1f.text: She's a... very old customer. Be nice.

v_9937d97b5a.speaker: walt
v_9937d97b5a.text: She's got a service window. It shuts tight.

v_01c5645e5f.speaker: walt
v_01c5645e5f.text: Shop's closed! Press Open Shop at the sign.

v_a9764de43f.speaker: walt
v_a9764de43f.text: Slice a bun while it cooks.

v_5b929e3129.speaker: walt
v_5b929e3129.text: Some of them might look a little off.

v_2bd5e253a0.speaker: walt
v_2bd5e253a0.text: Somebody has to keep the light on. Every night.

v_e69f4b8e6a.speaker: walt
v_e69f4b8e6a.text: Someone waving upstairs? Don't look up.

v_6acfda534a.speaker: walt
v_6acfda534a.text: Sometimes a customer shows up twice.

v_0f66a48c9a.speaker: walt
v_0f66a48c9a.text: Tap the frank box. It goes on the grill.

v_c47fe05658.speaker: walt
v_c47fe05658.text: Tell Opal it's for Walt. She knows.

v_f271c54c14.speaker: walt
v_f271c54c14.text: Ten nights. You kept the light on.

v_bf2f8e08a4.speaker: walt
v_bf2f8e08a4.text: That's what they wanted. Now serve it.

v_7664596356.speaker: walt
v_7664596356.text: The cart gets a rest. She takes the corner.

v_6d7b4f4a2e.speaker: walt
v_6d7b4f4a2e.text: The cart's right on the corner. Ninth and Juniper.

v_83d0e946e7.speaker: walt
v_83d0e946e7.text: The corner's a crossing, Rookie. At night, the late crowd comes through.

v_45ac098168.speaker: walt
v_45ac098168.text: The flyer? All of you? Huh. Nobody's called in years.

v_3fd580d157.speaker: walt
v_3fd580d157.text: The flyer? Huh. Nobody's called about that one in years.

v_f3e7afb49b.speaker: walt
v_f3e7afb49b.text: The night shift is yours. If you want it.

v_cbd6fbb50d.speaker: walt
v_cbd6fbb50d.text: The trailer's still there. Just saying.

v_b012f94f6d.speaker: walt
v_b012f94f6d.text: Then you get answers. I promise.

v_b13c545da3.speaker: walt
v_b13c545da3.text: There's your hot dog. Wait for an order.

v_7a14942b70.speaker: walt
v_7a14942b70.text: They just want someone to notice them.

v_a407bfc9ae.speaker: walt
v_a407bfc9ae.text: They like the light. And the smell of food. Heh.

v_0a6e58556b.speaker: walt
v_0a6e58556b.text: They want ketchup. Go add some.

v_7c71c93a17.speaker: walt
v_7c71c93a17.text: Tonight the street might go dark.

v_5d3728787b.speaker: walt
v_5d3728787b.text: Tonight, a lady in a yellow raincoat

v_c46d81aa1f.speaker: walt
v_c46d81aa1f.text: Toss it in the bin and make a new one.

v_a2963d550f.speaker: walt
v_a2963d550f.text: Toss it. Hold Throw Away at the bin.

v_d4f7ac67eb.speaker: walt
v_d4f7ac67eb.text: Two of them? Refuse the backwards one.

v_ef0bf5ade0.speaker: walt
v_ef0bf5ade0.text: Uh-oh... that was your last bun.

v_8f2cc7cc50.speaker: walt
v_8f2cc7cc50.text: Walk up to the sign. Buy her.

v_cfe1f59520.speaker: walt
v_cfe1f59520.text: Watch the grill. When the bar fills up... it's ready.

v_89bccc2718.speaker: walt
v_89bccc2718.text: We're open! Folks line up at the counter.

v_e5b27b2f09.speaker: walt
v_e5b27b2f09.text: Welcome to the real shop, Rookie.

v_ed8fc1a4c9.speaker: walt
v_ed8fc1a4c9.text: Whatever you do, never watch the Walker.

v_881d509ecc.speaker: walt
v_881d509ecc.text: When the bar fills up, grab it.

v_f0e1eb4f5c.speaker: walt
v_f0e1eb4f5c.text: When the far lamp buzzes, they're there.

v_2e4cd0ecb8.speaker: walt
v_2e4cd0ecb8.text: When the lamps start going out,

v_32047383d1.speaker: walt
v_32047383d1.text: Whoa... that's not what they ordered.

v_2ce5b99dc4.speaker: walt
v_2ce5b99dc4.text: You all noticed it. That counts for a lot. Heh.

v_800c90c4bc.speaker: walt
v_800c90c4bc.text: You bought the old girl! Heh.

v_79fe1b45ba.speaker: walt
v_79fe1b45ba.text: You kept your eyes down. Good.

v_cb6b890ca6.speaker: walt
v_cb6b890ca6.text: You'll be safer in there... mostly.

v_18bf1b4d18.speaker: walt
v_18bf1b4d18.text: in it you didn't take — toss it.

v_2df5bfcdb9.speaker: walt
v_2df5bfcdb9.text: never let them reach your light.

v_239299a132.speaker: walt
v_239299a132.text: no eyes, no mouth — don't serve them.
